exposure: Glycoside-based standardized fenugreek seed extract (SFSE-G) at 250, 500, and 1000 mg/kg
cohort: Mated female Wistar rats (30 per group) were randomized and received oral doses of SFSE-G or vehicle during gestation from gestational day 5 to gestational day 19.
finding: Oral exposure to glycoside-based standardized fenugreek seed extract (SFSE-G) during the prenatal period did not show significant maternal and embryo-fetal toxicity up to a dose of 1000 mg/kg in rats.
gest_age: Fetuses were examined at Gestational Day 20.
